row.title: STICKY-1: the stickiness step files its item with a small reserve above the daily item limit
row.body: The stickiness step now passes cap = ORIGINATE_MAX_PER_DAY + STICKY_RESERVE (5) to ensureItem. Item ids are fixed per system, so a refile is a no-op. Evidence: live D1 had stickiness_state rows but no STICKY items while budget_ledger showed 20 of 20 used. Verified by seed/worker/test/stickiness.test.js.
